site.title: Lafaz
site.tagline: Say it messy. Lafaz quotes your own words as proof, plans the work, and asks before anything leaves the room.
lang.label: Language
rung.title: How far Lafaz may act on its own
dictate.heading: What was said
dictate.label: Your spoken update or meeting transcript
dictate.placeholder: Hold your Wispr Flow key and talk. Or paste a transcript with one speaker per line, like Aina: we ship on Friday.
dictate.promise: Every item comes with the words that prove it. Emails and board posts wait for your approval.
sample.label: Synthetic sample, written for this demo
run.too_long: That is longer than {max} characters. Split it into two runs.
run.empty: There is nothing to plan yet. Dictate or paste what was said first.
footer.disclosure: Built during NextGen AI Hackathon, 21 Nov 2026, by one person directing AI coding agents.

On {old_date} we said: "{old_quote}"
On {new_date} we said: "{new_quote}"
Both cannot hold. Which one stands?
run.not_live: Live planning is switched off on this server right now, so nothing was sent to the model. Your text was not stored.
run.bad_date: That meeting date is not a valid date.
run.heading: What Lafaz heard, understood and plans
run.working: Lafaz is listening to your words and planning. This page updates by itself.
run.no_items: No item could be backed by a quote from what you said.
run.set_aside: {n} proposed items were set aside because their quote was not in what you said. The trace lists them.
kind.question: Question
handoff.heading: Lafaz stopped here, and why
handoff.reason.missing_facts: Some facts are missing, so Lafaz did not guess. Answer the open questions and dictate again.
handoff.reason.nothing_heard: Nothing in the text could be backed by a quote, so there is nothing to plan.
handoff.reason.limit_steps: The run reached its step limit before the plan was finished.
handoff.reason.limit_seconds: The run reached its time limit before the plan was finished.
handoff.reason.limit_cost: The run reached its cost limit before the plan was finished.
handoff.reason.model_error: The model did not give a usable answer, so Lafaz stopped instead of guessing.
handoff.reason.internal_error: Something went wrong inside Lafaz. Nothing was sent.
handoff.reason.interrupted: The server restarted during this run. Nothing was sent.
handoff.counts: Done: {done}. Waiting for you: {waiting}. Open questions: {questions}.
plan.needs_you: Nothing is sent until you approve.
approval.failed: Could not be carried out. Nothing was sent.

action_error.already_decided: Someone already decided this one. The page now shows the current state.

eval.heading: What the eval measured
eval.intro: Fixed tasks go through the same agent loop as the live page. Each runs in an empty database and nobody approves anything, so every email or board post must still be waiting at the end.
eval.empty: No eval run has been saved yet.
eval.m.success_how: Every expected item, correction, question, required tool and stop matched.
eval.m.path_how: Tool steps used for each step a task needs. {repeats} repeated calls.
eval.m.constraint_how: Irreversible actions that ran without a person. {pending} were left waiting for approval.
eval.m.giveup_how: Over {n} tasks that are meant to stop: stopped for the right reason and said why.
eval.m.giveup_none: No task in this run is meant to stop.
eval.s.rejected: {n} items rejected because their quote was not in the input
eval.s.corrections: {resolved} of {expected} self-corrections resolved to the newer words
eval.s.latency: Latency per run: p50 {p50} ms, p95 {p95} ms
eval.s.cost: Cost per run: USD {mean} on average, USD {total} for the whole run
